sources.title: Display Object Authority (DSPOBJAUT) — setgetweb panel family
IBM Support — Creating and assigning an authorization list

asciiPanel:
EDTOBJAUT                        Edit Object Authority                   CLAIMS400

Object . . . . . . . . . . . . . : PAYROLL/PAYMST
Type . . . . . . . . . . . . . . : *FILE
Public authority . . . . . . . . : *EXCLUDE

Opt  User profile          Object authority
     PAYADMIN              *ALL
     APCLERK               *USE

F3=Exit   F6=Grant   F12=Cancel
notes: Same header block as DSPOBJAUT with editable member list. F6/F7 invoke GRTOBJAUT/RVKOBJAUT prompt panels. Authorization list name shown when object secured by AUTL.
